name: singlet_enrichment_over_representation_analysis
title: Over-representation analysis of a gene list
description: Tests whether a thresholded marker or differential-expression gene list overlaps each gene set in a named collection more than chance allows, against a stated background universe. Writes one row per set with overlap, odds ratio, fold enrichment, p-value and adjusted p-value. Use for cluster or DE annotation with a predefined collection; do not use it for rank-based enrichment or for per-cell scores.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

de_table.description: Name of the marker or DE table under uns/de/ with gene, group, logfc, pval and padj columns.

collection.description: Gene-set collection under uns/gene_sets/. Required; there is no default collection.

method.description: One-sided hypergeometric (default), two-sided Fisher, or EASE-reduced Fisher.

universe.description: Background universe that defines the population size N.

mode.description: Detected: genes passing min_cells; tested: DE table genes; annotated: all genes; var_column: boolean var column.

min_cells.description: Minimum cells expressing a gene for the detected universe (proposed default).

var_key.description: Boolean var column used only when mode is var_column.

foreground.description: Thresholds that define the foreground gene list from the DE table.

padj_threshold.description: Adjusted p-value cut-off for foreground genes.

min_logfc.description: Absolute log fold-change cut-off; null applies no fold-change filter.

direction.description: Sign of the score that defines the foreground.

top_n.description: Use the top N genes by score instead of thresholds when set.

sets.description: Size filters applied after intersection with the universe.

min_size.description: Minimum set size after intersection with the universe (proposed default).

max_size.description: Maximum set size after intersection with the universe (proposed default).

min_overlap.description: Minimum number of foreground genes in a set before it is reported (proposed default).

correction.description: Multiplicity adjustment across the sets of one list and collection.

ha_corr.description: Haldane-Anscombe correction added to each cell for the reported odds ratio only.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing the tests.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written: uns/ora/<name> and uns/ora/<name>/meta. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Counts for completed calls: foreground size, universe size, sets tested, sets significant, method and correction.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
